title: Retention Change
description: Stops a shorter data-retention period from destroying data by surprise by saying exactly what goes and when (“Lowering to 30 days deletes 14,210 events older than 13 Sep, tonight at 02:00”), shading the doomed days on a chart, counting down to the purge while changing it back still loses nothing, and naming the confirm button “Delete without export” until an export-first is done.
stops: Shorter retention purged months of data
